node.title: Quotient-closed G1 and K4 fit current plus intrinsic descendants in one n^6 allocation
node.statement: On every rate-preserving quotient row n>=256, assume G1 supplies a finite paid atlas with sum_chi(m_chi+1)<=(121/128)n^6. K4 bounds each chart by m_chi+1, so first-match summation gives the same primitive payment. The intrinsic geometric ledger then bounds the current row plus all proper descendants by less than (64/63)(121/128)n^6=(121/126)n^6. Together with quotient descent and exact-support projection, this proves the small-scale census conditional only on weighted G1. || RE-POSED AT IMPORT (catch #116): the branch marked this PROVED via an asserted, nowhere-proved classification lemma — re-posed CONDITIONAL on petal_g1_layer_maps + petal_descent_classification_bridge; ev-wired ALTERNATE to the census gate (master's successor-red route stands). || RETIRED (2026-07-13, catch #150): this alternate hypothesizes exactly the falsified weighted form + the 64/63 rider (g1a-unsatisfiable, #148) — the audit's D4 fate-sweep caught it as the one missed consumer. Superseded by Lemma COL + clause (D).
